posts.text: Just over a week ago, my team placed 1st at the Accenture x Western Founders Network Pitch the Future Case Competition, earning the $1,000 prize! 🏆 For my first-ever university case competition, we developed an AI-powered solution to address housekeeping inefficiencies at a fictional hotel network. Our proposal combined card readers, a centralized AI platform, and radio earpieces to track cleaning progress, predict room readiness, and keep staff updated in real time. A huge thank you to my teamm
